title: 16509 - 16509/P0125
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Insufficient warm up time of the engine
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  specifications of ECT sensor
technicalNotes: Indicates that the Engine Coolant Temperature (ECT) sensor has not achieved the required temperature level to enter closed loop operating conditions within a specified amount of time after starting engine.
